institution: Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Computer Science (School of Cyber Science and Engineering; School of Cryptography)
sourceDescription: The official current faculty directory was retrieved through its public grouped-directory endpoint with type=1, which returns all institute groups without pagination. The official visiting/dual/guest and retired-faculty pages were also captured. The visiting/dual/guest extraction is restricted to each official name-list container so footer QR-code and regulatory links are not counted. Institute memberships, appointment categories, and retirement years are preserved; repeated official profile IDs and exact names across categories are merged for a unique-person total.
